humanityNarrative.heading: From hospital work to school and community programs
humanityNarrative.text: An Influential Women profile describes her earlier path from hospital psychotherapy and lead-therapist work to recruitment to help establish trauma-informed schools in Pennsylvania. It says she later created and oversaw an at-risk program across three Washington, DC schools, including wraparound support and grief counseling for displaced families during the COVID-19 pandemic.
